title: Mistral Romance Companion becomes easier to find
summary:
Mistral Romance Companion moved to the flower tier while image defaults, generation limits, and queue diagnostics were tuned.

Mistral Small 2402 Romance Companion was unhidden and moved from the nectar tier to the flower tier. It also has `mistral-nemo-instruct-2407-romance` and `mistral-roblox` aliases.

Image requests without dimensions now use `sideLength` for width and height instead of capping them at 1024. Flux’s maximum side length dropped from 1280 to 768, and Azure GPT-4.1’s two token-limit settings dropped from 1024 to 512.

Queue-full and text-service error logs gained user context, with separate logging for 429s. Error response JSON stayed the same; two text-transform import casing issues were also corrected.

highlights.title: Mistral Romance Companion opens up
highlights.text: Mistral Small 2402 Romance Companion was unhidden and moved to the flower tier. It supports the `mistral-nemo-instruct-2407-romance` and `mistral-roblox` aliases. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-nemo-instruct-2407-romance).
